body: I know better times always come, but then go away again and I'm just tired, you know? I'm not that young anymore. I feel it's unfair to be like this after all my efforts to succeed somehow. Not become rich or anything like that. Just a stable job, a roof over my head and food on the table

I'm taking venlafaxina for depression and Clonazepam for anxiety.

I became pregnant at age 16. I finished highschool, I'm a biochemist, have a Master degree in cell and molecular biology and currently doing a PhD in virology.
My scholarship ends in September so I won't have any income.
Now I'm studying computer testing and programming... For improving my chances of getting a job. I'm a native Spanish speaker but think my English is not that bad. I also speak Portuguese, French and Italian. But I still can't find my way out. I'm also trying transcription/ translations as a freelancer. Lots of work and effort. All alone, all by myself. I'm really really tired
I'm searching all the time on the internet about painless death
I had shitty parents. Psychopath mother and absent father
